text:
maria: heads up — master CI is red after the deps bump that merged from dependabot this morning. failing tests show up in unit/schema on linux-py310. can someone take a look? @eng-infra

dev-bot: CI job 376 failed — pytest exited 1 — https://ci.internal.redwood/376

jon: re-ran the job, still failing (not flaky).

sasha: here's the top of the traceback i grabbed from the worker logs:
```
E   TypeError: BaseModel.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'json_schema'
  File ".../site-packages/pydantic/main.py", line 48, in __init__
```

liam: that looks like a pydantic v2 vs v1 API mismatch. did dependabot bump pydantic?

maria: yep — dependabot changed pydantic 1.10.12 -> 2.0.0 in poetry.lock as part of the regen.

jon: ok. can someone bisect the lockfile bump? simple approach: checkout main, roll back poetry.lock to prior commit, run `poetry install` and pytest to confirm which lock change introduced break.

sasha: i'll take it. plan: 1) try pinning pydantic to 1.10.x in pyproject.toml locally, 2) run `pytest unit/schema -k model_init` to get a minimal repro, 3) if confirmed open a revert PR.

liam: if pin fixes it, we should revert the lock change and add a concrete constraint in pyproject so dependabot doesn't reintroduce pydantic 2 until we're ready. also add a note in the changelog.

maria: @sasha please drop the CI job link and the tiny reproducer here once you have it. if pin fixes, i'll create the revert PR and tag platform for release notes.

sasha: starting local run now — will paste logs when done :hourglass:

dev-bot: job rerun started by sasha

sasha: run finished — pinning pydantic==1.10.12 fixes the failing tests locally. opening revert PR now.

maria: thanks — add a short explanation in the PR about pydantic v2 incompatibility with our serializers. we should schedule an upgrade plan later.

jon: cc @eng-ml in case any model infra depends on v2 features; otherwise revert is safest for now.

maria: closing loop — revert PR opened (will link once CI passes) :white_check_mark:
